mutations.name: line columns rise from zero whatever the baseline
kills: a chart drawn from its frame slots a line chart's columns rise from its baseline, which the axis names

mutations.name: bars grow from zero whatever the baseline
kills: a chart drawn from its frame slots bars on a negative baseline grow from that baseline, not from zero

mutations.name: bars drop their scale colour
kills: a chart drawn from its frame slots a sequential scale colours each bar by its value, low to high

mutations.name: a diverging scale centres on zero, not the baseline
kills: a chart drawn from its frame slots a diverging scale centres its middle colour on the baseline

mutations.name: the chart draws no legend
kills: a chart drawn from its frame slots a legend names every series beside its colour
